TEJAX KART / PLAYER HANDBOOK

Built for
one more lap.

TEJAX KART: Apex Protocol is a free 3D arcade racing game for web browsers. It combines circuit racing with optional vehicle combat, local career scores and customizable cars.

Game facts

NameTEJAX KART: Apex Protocol
Edition6.5 · Apex Protocol
PriceFree; all 6 unique chassis, liveries, rims & paints unlocked
PlatformsDesktop & Mobile Installable Web App (PWA) on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android & iOS
VehiclesScout, Titan, Assassin, Vector, Apex and Rally — each with a custom 3D silhouette & unique ultimate
CircuitsNeo City, Crimson Canyon, Glacier Ridge, Obsidian Caldera, Orbital Skyway & Sunset Marina
Solo modesRace, Combat, Elimination, Survival and Time trial (with Global Ghost Leaderboards)
Multiplayer2–6 players worldwide via Cloudflare Edge — Friends-Only (no bots) or AI backfill, custom laps & live lobby loadouts
InputsKeyboard, mouse, Gamepad/Controller, touch and mobile tilt
RenderingThree.js / WebGL with custom bloom, banked circuits, tunnels & sub-tick smooth interpolation

What changed in 6.5?

Added 6 sculpted vehicle silhouettes with procedural liveries and wheel rims, banked corners with tunnels and live sector split gates, Sunset Marina (6th circuit), Friends-Only multiplayer with real player names, live overhead HP/rank tags, in-lobby customization, host migration, full post-race podiums, and upgraded Desktop & Mobile PWA app installation.

Open source and credits

The project source is distributed under the MIT license. Three.js and the optional ws server dependency retain their own MIT notices. The repository includes its license and third-party notices. The cars and track geometry are generated in code.

Designed for choice

Adjust graphics quality, difficulty, weather, volume, camera motion and driving keys. Progress stays in your browser. There is no account requirement, paid car unlock, or cloud leaderboard.
